title: TOGEARI: Interaction-Space Preconditioning for Condensed Finite-Element Systems with IPC Contact
summary: TOGEARI constructs a compressed contact correction for condensed finite-element equations with incremental potential contact (IPC). A core-conditioned interaction matrix ranks contact combinations by their mechanical responses; a raw-factor proxy acquires only the retained responses. For a symmetric positive-definite core, the reference analysis gives the exact spectrum, scaled inverse error and optimal worst omitted interaction.
